# Beta Repo

## Project

Beta is the documentation service repository for the workspace-trio test fixture.
Used by Phase 30 workspace orchestration tests.

### Constraints

- POSIX bash + Node.js .mjs hooks.
- Documentation files must be in Markdown format.

## Technology Stack

Minimal test harness with docs skill.

## Conventions

- Use the docs skill for all documentation tasks.
- Keep docs co-located with code where possible.

## Architecture

Standard conjure harness layout with documentation skill.
